THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Mint Chip feat. Candy Cane Creami

Peppermint-chocolate Ninja Creami: Nurri 2% milk and unflavored whey isolate with 1/4 tsp mint extract, respun with 7g Lily’s chocolate melted with 3/4 tsp coconut oil, and topped with 2 crushed mini candy canes. About 310 calories and 35g protein for the whole finished pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME5 min active + 24 hr freeze
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~310 cal | ~35g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Melt the 7g Lily’s chocolate with 3/4 tsp coconut oil gently so it pours smoothly and shatters into fine chocolate flecks during the Respin cycle (no extra liquid added).

Ingredients

BASE

  • 1 cup (240 ml) Nurri plain 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 1/2 labeled serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (60 cal / 14g protein)
  • 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum, leveled
  • Pinch of salt
  • 1/4 tsp mint extract
  • Optional green food coloring

CHOCOLATE

  • 7g Lily’s chocolate chips/melts
  • 3/4 tsp coconut oil

TOPPING

  • 2 mini candy canes, crushed

Allergens: dairy.

You want a festive mint-chip and candy-cane ice cream pint for ~310 calories and 35g protein where melted chocolate and coconut oil shatter into fine chocolate flecks during the Respin cycle.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND & FREEZE (24 HOURS). Blend all base ingredients (Nurri 2% milk, unflavored whey isolate, sweetener, guar gum, salt, mint extract, and optional green coloring) until smooth. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.
  2. 2.FIRST SPIN & MELTED CHOCOLATE DRIZZLE. Rest the frozen pint for 5 minutes, then run Regular Ice Cream. Gently melt 7g Lily’s chocolate with 3/4 tsp coconut oil until smooth and drizzle over the spun mint ice cream.
  3. 3.RESPIN FOR STRACCIATELLA CHIP TEXTURE. Run Respin without adding liquid so the machine shatters and distributes the chocolate throughout the mint ice cream.
  4. 4.CRUSHED CANDY CANE FINISH. Crush the 2 mini candy canes and scatter them on top after processing. Scoop and enjoy.

Keys to success

  • Add the 2 crushed mini candy canes on top after processing so they keep their crisp peppermint crunch.
  • Total carbohydrate is not asserted as a single fixed number because sweetener sugar-alcohol labeling and mini candy-cane weights vary by brand.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the blended mint base upright and level for up to 1 week. Spin, drizzle melted chocolate, respin, and top with crushed candy canes right before serving.

Reheat: Do not heat the pint; melt only the 7g chocolate and 3/4 tsp coconut oil.

Lasts: Unspun pint keeps 1 week frozen; enjoy immediately after adding crushed candy canes.

Estimated nutrition

~310 cal | ~35g protein per 1 whole finished pint (including chocolate, coconut oil, and both mini candy canes).

Reference estimate for the whole finished pint (including chocolate, coconut oil, and both mini candy canes): ≈310 calories and 35g protein (310.3 kcal / 34.5g protein calculated).
